name: Ropes

pages.text: $(thing)Rope$() can be strung up to climb down cliffs and shafts. To hang a rope, $(item)$(k:key.use)$() it on the tip of a $(thing)Rock Spike$(), or on a $(thing)Steel Rope Anchor$(). This ties off the rope and turns the block into an anchor.

$(item)$(k:key.use)$() the rope again to throw it out in the direction you are facing, laying down rope that you can climb. To recall the rope, $(item)$(k:key.use)$() the anchor with an empty hand. The rope will be destroyed, the spike will turn back into an anchor, and the items returned to you.
$(thing)Rock Spikes$() cannot be picked up, so the $(thing)Steel Rope Anchor$() can be crafted and placed wherever you need an anchor instead.
